en: The Dyad on the Visible (Sanidassanaduka), The Triad on the Visible (Sanidassanattika)
Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-visible and non-reactive, there arises a phenomenon that is visible and reactive by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. One [condition] in the case of root; one in the case of predominance … pe … one in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a phenomenon that is non-visible and non-reactive, there arises a phenomenon that is invisible and reactive by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] in the case of root; one in the case of predominance … pe … one in the case of non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-demonstrable, and non-reactive, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, non-demonstrable, and non-reactive by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition there is one; under predominance-condition there is one …pe… under non-disappearance-condition there is one.
